title: Upstream Influence, Downstream Re-Anchoring in LLM Agent Chains
abstract: arXiv:2610.17723v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: People act on evaluative judgments produced by LLM agents, and in multi-agent systems those judgments pass through several agents before reaching a person. We show that a workflow's information architecture---source access, handoff format, and which model reads the untrusted content---governs how much of a coordinated manipulation reaches the end. On 32 Taiwan~2025 recall cases, ten authentic Threads comments shown to one agent move its stance by $+0.171$ toward the injected position, and a mirrored set moves it the other way. Passing that judgment down a chain removes more than half of the shift by the third agent; keeping the comments in front of every agent sustains more of it. translated_title: LLM智能体链中的上游影响与下游再锚定
translated_abstract: 人们会依据LLM智能体产生的评价性判断采取行动，而在多智能体系统中，这些判断在到达人类之前需要经过多个智能体的传递。我们证明了工作流的信息架构——即源头访问方式、交接格式以及由哪个模型阅读不可信内容——决定了一致性操纵有多少能够最终影响到人。在32个台湾2025年罢免案例上，向一个智能体展示十条真实的Threads评论会使其立场向被注入的观点移动+0.171，而一组镜像的评论则会使其向相反方向移动。将该判断沿链条向下传递时，到第三个智能体时位移会被削弱一半以上；而让每个智能体都直接看到这些评论，则能维持更多的操纵影响。这种衰减并非传递途中的损耗：每个接收者会根据继承立场与自身对证据解读之间的偏差程度成比例地将其折扣，回归到该证据对此案例所隐含的判断，而非回归中立——这与部分再锚定的机制相一致。
tldr: 该研究揭示了LLM多智能体链中工作流的信息架构（源头访问、交接格式、由哪个模型阅读不可信内容）决定协调操纵的影响程度，且操纵影响会沿链条逐级衰减——每个下游智能体会根据自身对证据的独立解读对继承的立场进行“再锚定”，回归证据本身的含义而非中立或简单传递。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that a workflow's information architecture—source access, handoff format, and which model reads untrusted content—governs how much coordinated manipulation reaches the end of LLM agent chains, and that manipulative influence decays downstream because each agent re-anchors the inherited stance toward its own reading of the evidence rather than simply passing it along or returning to neutrality.
